abilities.title: Predict its own movement effects
abilities.sub: Different choices lead to different outcomes.
abilities.looks: Before moving, distinguish how the available commands will change its body.
abilities.next: Find out which predicted consequences help it choose better.

abilities.title: Choose movements for its own wellness
abilities.sub: Act because the expected result is better for itself.
abilities.looks: Choose a movement whose actual result improves bodily wellness according to its present needs.
abilities.next: Test whether learned self perception forecasts how movements change functioning, then whether its choices restore functioning. Live self learning is enabled; the earlier chooser still controls movement.

abilities.title: Turn its body to restore comfort
abilities.sub: A coordinated change of position that serves a current need.
abilities.looks: Turn toward a selected body state, stop there, and recover after a disturbance. A side turn or roll is visible in the measured body posture.
abilities.next: Test a frozen model in matched worlds. Measure actual body-axis roll and restored comfort, and separate purposeful correction from flopping or turning around the pen.

abilities.title: Correct a look when the situation changes
abilities.sub: Follow what it selected, then settle on it.
abilities.looks: Adjust a chosen look when its target moves, and stop turning once the target is in view.
abilities.next: Record its selected look, then move or remove the toy and measure the correction. Separate reflexes and competing needs.

abilities.title: Keep and combine learned abilities
abilities.sub: Reuse a skill after a reset and within a longer act.
abilities.looks: Retain an acquired ability and use it as part of a new sequence, such as reaching, grasping, and holding.
abilities.next: Attach retention and combination tests when an ability is demonstrated.

abilities.title: Reach and take hold of an object
abilities.sub: Make contact, then control what happens to the object.
abilities.looks: Reach a chosen free object, close the fingers around it, lift and release it where intended.
abilities.next: Verify a reachable physical grasp, then test acquisition and later retention under changed object positions.

abilities.title: Use support to raise its body
abilities.sub: Turn contact with a handhold into a controlled body lift.
abilities.looks: Reach a support, sustain contact and move its weight onto its feet without an external lift.
abilities.next: Verify a reachable handhold and muscle sequence; compare learned support use with the matched controls.

abilities.title: Use what it learned in UE Avatar
abilities.sub: Adapt knowledge to a different body and richer senses.
abilities.looks: Use lessons from MIMo to acquire or perform an ability in UE Avatar.
abilities.next: Compare transferred learning with the same UE model starting without it.

records.summary: The separate predictor learned movement effects in every fresh world. It failed its required advantage over the linear predictor in two worlds.

records.subject: Saved/mimo_bridge/experiments/H69_slots6400_resume_20260910_115740/checkpoints/ckpt_step_3623826
records.title: Forecast-based choices showed no added benefit.
records.summary: The separate forecasts beat holding still, but did not demonstrate an improvement over the tested planner.
records.missing: Neither a new purposeful skill in the running model nor a specific cause of the failed improvement is established.
records.method: Nine worlds; compare realized touch comfort, muscle capacity and posture. The reported interval for benefit over the planner includes zero. That is not proof of equivalence or absence of pain. The evaluator's harm check does not establish safety. Contact geometry is a candidate explanation, not an isolated cause.

records.subject: D:/UEMA_Research/external/D/UEMA_scratch/h84/d1_planner_recovery/attempts/target_unblended_496250_u_a2/evidence/run/TUNBL_u_496250_a2/checkpoints/ckpt_step_496256
records.title: Sending the reach command unblended moved 14 of 16 hands nearer their targets in 250 ms.
records.summary: From the same saved state (model step 496,250, all 8 bodies), the unblended target command left 14 of 16 hands nearer their target handle than the saved blended run, median 3.47 cm nearer; the other 2 hands (body 7, selected in neither run) were the same. Example: body 0's left wrist ended 17.78 cm from its target with the blend and 2.48 cm without it. The command was chosen for 7 of 8 bodies instead of 4.
records.missing: Arriving within 2 cm by model step 40 and staying 20 more model steps is not measured: this is one 250 ms window after one decision, 6 learning steps. Next: command continuity (planner commands every 5 versus 10 model steps) with arrival and hold measured. Contact forces rose for bodies 4 and 5.
records.method: Paired comparison through the reviewed owner: the same START, eight worlds and saved control; gates G1 to G8 pass; the selection change is reported, not separated from the movement.
